g.title: place_archived
g.text: Source master streamed into our S3 (museado). imgproxy reads it via s3://.

g.title: place_informed
g.text: imgproxy /info fetched: dimensions, byte size, format, hash from s3:// source.

g.title: place_triaged
g.text: Triage observations recorded (caption, ocr_text, keywords from ai-tools /v1/responses)

g.title: place_ai_ready
g.text: AI task pipeline active — aiQueue has pending tasks

g.title: place_deleted
g.text: Asset + its archive object deleted (terminal). Set immediately before row removal.
